ns2:course.label: Dietary Prevention of Cardiovascular and Other Chronic Diseases
ns2:course.description: The goals of the course are to learn a biochemical and molecular basis of functions and metabolism of essential fatty acids and cholesterol, and the implications to chronic disease prevention and dietary recommendations. Same as NUTR 522. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent enrollment in MCB 450 or any introductory biochemistry course; and MCB 244 or MCB 246 or any introductory physiology course; and FSHN 420; or consent of instructor.
